# 關鍵字高亮設定檔 - 格式：關鍵字=顏色
# 統一使用藍色高亮，避免與程式預設顏色衝突

# 長關鍵字優先
BT init succeeds=blue
192.168.11.143=blue

# 常用關鍵字（統一藍色）
success=blue
successfully=blue
fail=blue
error=blue
connect=blue
connected=blue
disconnect=blue
warning=blue
timeout=blue
ready=blue
complete=blue
start=blue
stop=blue
pass=blue
test=blue
version=blue
status=blue
power=blue
led=blue
ping=blue
response=blue
